title: add skylint check for missing rule documentation

timeline.body:
Note that there's now a doc attribute:
```
new_rule = rule(
  implementation = _new_rule_impl,
  attrs = {
    "foo": attr.label(),
    "bar": attr.string(),
  },
  doc = """some documentation"""
)
```

So maybe we should recommend that instead of a docstring?
you are right. I forgot this attribute. I will change it to use the doc attributes of the rules and their attributes.

timeline.body: Erm, tried to fix the conflict in the contributor file, but it looks like it created a much messier merge commit.

This will raise a linter error if the docstring is factored into a variable or otherwise constructed programmatically. We actually have instances in Bazel where our own docstrings are factored -- see for instance [SkylarkRuleContextApi](https://github.com/bazelbuild/bazel/blob/0.16.1/src/main/java/com/google/devtools/build/lib/skylarkbuildapi/SkylarkRuleContextApi.java#L49).

I think the presence of a "doc" argument should be enough to satisfy the check, regardless of its content.
Same issue, no need for the docstring to be literal here. Note that Stardoc (Skydoc renamed) will actually evaluate the code to extract the dynamically produced docstring value.

reply.body: i think its for the missing one-line summary

Ok, now I see. The -1 is there to get the last column on the line (inclusive), and the `max(1, ...)` ensures this can't cause it to dip down to col 0, which doesn't exist, in the case that the line is empty. Your change generalizes this to also work when it's the first line that is empty (where startColumn isn't 1), so that in that case we still get a proper issue rather than what I presume is a stack trace due to a bad LocationRange.

timeline.body: There should also be a new subsection of the docstrings section describing how to document rules and rule attrs. (Unlike for functions, there's no precise format for the string content, but we need to at least say that the `doc` param should be present.) This new subsection can be the anchor target of the new issue types `missing-rule-documentation` and `missing-attribute-documentation` (see use of `<a>` tags for the existing sections).

reply.body: i uses the format of skydoc (https://skydoc.bazel.build/docs/writing.html). the doc format should be matching.
In that case, can we change "the one-line summary is missing" to "docstrings must begin with a one-line summary (with no preceding newline)"? That way we avoid a confusing error message in this case.
